task.title: Actioning the fraudulent renewal — Client is not requesting benefits

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim is active or terminated:

ul.li: If the claim is terminated but can be reactivated, select the appropriate BPC on the Dormant tab and select Reactivate . Go to step 2.
If the claim is active, go to step 3.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the AI WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + one business day.
When the WI moves to the current workload, go to step 3.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there are cycling claimant’s reports completed by a third party:
Select the Additional Data (M107) transaction and input the RTW week to reject the cycling claimant’s reports as follows:

ul.li: Return to work: Select the Monday of the first cycling claimant’s repor t displayed in FTS.

step.cmd: Select the Additional Data (M107) transaction and input the RTW week as follows:

ul.li: Return to work: Select the Monday of the week after the last payment issued to a third party displayed in FTS.

step.cmd: Determine if there is an MA71 imposed to stop payments:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and rescind the MA71 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.
Manual action: Select 71 - Integrity Services case .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Detection: This field is prefilled according to the type of investigation in NIIS.
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .

step.cmd: In SPS, for each payment issued to a third party, determine if the payment must be cancelled :

ul.li: If yes, note the payment reference number, the amount (gross benefits and net amount), w/c, BT, CT and the date the payment was processed. This information is required on the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) Go to step 9.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.
Detection: This field is prefilled according to the type of investigation in NIIS.
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 54 - Third party fraud .
Remarks line 1: Type “Cancel fraudulent renewal w/c [XXXX]. Unknown third party.”

Remark lines 2–4: For all payments to be removed, type “Remove w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX]. Total amount $[XXXX]. Adjust tax file or T4E. No OP for client.” If payments have been returned or cheques were never cashed, type “Also cancel returned payments or uncashed cheques, as appropriate, for w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX].” For each payment, type “w/c [XXXX] / [T071-2 for current year or T071-8 for the previous year] / reason F / CT [XX] / gross benefits [XXXX] / federal tax [XX] / provincial tax [XX] (if necessary) / net amount [XXXX] / PRN [XXXXXXXXXXXX].” Type “Client is not requesting benefits.” If an MA was imposed to stop payments, type “Rescind MA [XX].” If, as a result of the recalculation due to a deleted fraudulent ROE, a disqualification must be imposed from the same BPC as the fraudulent renewal application, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX].” If a disentitlement must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
